name: sign-packet (signed packets, named by their hash, chained per key)
description: The signed-packet core that registers and transports are built on (register-engine and packet-relay in this collection; AOF ADR 0024): canonical JSON, an SSH Ed25519 signature, an id that is the SHA-256 of the body, and a chain per key (seq, prev, saw). A Python library that makes, checks and orders packets, with no registers, kinds or rosters, and a sign-packet command that checks packet files alone. Keeps one thing: this running instance's id (one GUID per container, the part after @ in its agents' principals), in a named volume.

installTaskfile.description: Install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under sign-packet: in a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (the go-task Feature).
